BenchmarkEntry.description: One benchmark the registry knows: named by the manifest, or imported.

format.description:
The format that reads it: `beir`, `beir-qa` or `squad`; `unknown` for
an import whose record cannot be read.

ground_truth.description:
The ground truth it carries, read off the loaded dataset; `null` when
nothing on disk loaded.

licence.description:
The dataset's licence, for a benchmark the manifest names, whatever
its state: a downloaded dataset keeps the notice it was obtained
under. `null` for an import, whose licence is its owner's.

licence_url.description: Where that licence is stated; `null` with it.

name.description:
Its selector, `<format>/<dir>` — `beir/scifact` — as `ragondin bench
--benchmark` takes it; for an import whose record cannot be read, its
directory's name alone.

state.description: Where it stands against the digest expected of it.

benchmarks.description: The manifest's entries in manifest order, then the imports by name.

BenchmarkState.description:
Where a benchmark stands. Every verdict is a statement about digests: the
dataset on disk is loaded and its `dataset_version` compared with the one
expected — the manifest's, or the one recorded at import.

oneOf.description: On disk, and its digest is the manifest's.
Named by the manifest, not on disk.
On disk, and its digest is another.
On disk, and it does not load.
Imported, and its digest is the one recorded at import.

Capabilities.description:
What this build can run: the local implementations of each family, and
whether it can call a `Remote` one.

families.description: One entry per family, as the launcher lists them.

remote.description: Whether this build carries the `remote` feature.

DatasetCheck.description:
Whether the dataset on disk is the one a run was evaluated on: the
benchmark pinned to the run's `dataset_version`, digesting to it — and,
for passage text, its derived chunk set digesting to the run's
`index_version`.

benchmark.description:
The benchmark the run's `dataset_version` is pinned to, by its
selector; `null` when the registry pins no benchmark to it.

detail.description: The verdict in words: what was compared, and what differed.

found.description:
The digests of what is on disk, as far as they were computed; `null`
when nothing on disk loaded.

oneOf.description:
On disk, and every digest compared is the run's: the dataset's for
the ground truth, the dataset's and the chunk set's for passage text.
Not on disk, or pinned by no benchmark the registry knows.
On disk, and its digest is not the run's `dataset_version`.
On disk, and it does not load: `detail` carries the adapter's error.

Passage text only: the dataset is the run's, but the chunk set this
build derives from it does not digest to the run's `index_version` —
the derivation moved. The scores are unaffected.

DatasetVersions.description: The two dataset digests of a run's identity.

EdgeKind.description: The kind of value travelling along an edge.

oneOf.description: The question.
A list of retrieved chunks.
An assembled context.
A generator's answer.
A value an extension node produces, unknown to the core.

EdgeLocation.description: An edge, as a location names it.

from.description: The producing node or declared input.

port.description: The position of the edge among `to`'s inputs, from 0.

FamilyCapabilities.description: One family's local implementations in this build.

family.description:
The family, spelled as `--remote` and a service binding spell it: a
node family as a configuration's `component:` value, or `embedder`,
which no node is and a `dense` node names with `embedder:`.

local.description:
The names this build gives a `Local` component in it: `impl:` values,
or for `embedder`, `embedder:` values.

FoundVersions.description: The digests of the dataset on disk.

dataset_version.description: What the dataset on disk digests to.

index_version.description:
What its derived chunk set digests to; `null` when it was not
compared — the dataset already differs, or the check is the ground
truth's, which depends on the dataset alone.

Graph.description:
A pipeline as a graph: its declared inputs, its nodes and the edges
between them.

edges.description:
One edge per entry of a node's `inputs`, grouped by consuming node in
node order, then in port order.

inputs.description: The values the pipeline receives from its caller, in declared order.

nodes.description: The nodes, sorted by id — the canonical order.

GraphEdge.description: A data edge: `from`'s output feeds `to`'s input at `port`.

from.description: The producing node, or a declared input.

kind.description: The kind of value the producer puts on it.

port.description: The position of this edge among `to`'s inputs, from 0.

id.description: The id nodes name it by.

kind.description: What it carries: the query, for every pipeline this build reads.

family.description:
Its component family, spelled as a configuration's `component:`
value: `retriever`, `fusion`, `reranker`, `context_builder`,
`generator` or `extension`.

implementation.description: Its `impl:` name; an extension node's kind.

GroundTruth.description:
The ground truth a benchmark carries: which metric families a run over it
can compute.

oneOf.description: Neither qrels nor reference answers.
Qrels: the retrieval metrics.
Reference answers: the generation metrics against reference.
Both.

ImportRequest.description: `POST /benchmarks/import`: a corpus on disk, and the name to import it as.

name.description: The local benchmark's name: one directory name.

path.description:
The directory holding the corpus and its ground truth, on the
server's disk.

Layout.description:
Where the editor draws each node: UI metadata beside the document, never
in its hash. Also the body of `PUT /pipelines/{name}/layout`.

nodes.description: Each node's position, by node id.

version.description: The layout format's version: `1`, the only one this build reads.

Location.description: Where in a pipeline a validation failure is.

edge.description: The edge concerned, when there is one.

node.description: The node concerned, when there is one.

NodeMetrics.description: One node's ranking metrics over the run.

judged_queries.description:
How many queries the means are over: the judged queries for which the
node produced a ranking. A query without qrels is never in it, as it
is never in the harness's means; `0` when the ground truth is not
verified.

metrics.description:
The ranking metrics of its ranking, averaged over `judged_queries`;
`null` when that is none, or when the ground truth is not verified.

produces_ranking.description:
Whether the node produced a ranking for at least one query. A context
builder, a generator and a node that failed on every query did not.

document.description: The document, byte for byte as the file holds it.

error.description: Why it does not validate, when it does not.

etag.description: The digest of those bytes; also the response's `ETag` header, quoted.

hash.description: The content hash of its canonical logical form, when it validates.

PipelineDocument.description:
`PUT /pipelines/{name}` and `POST /pipelines/validate`: a pipeline
document, as text.

document.description:
The YAML document. Stored byte for byte when it is written: never
re-serialized.

PipelineError.description:
Why a pipeline document does not validate: `pipeline_invalid`'s detail and
location, inside a response that still answers.

detail.description: What the validation pass said, in the words `ragondin validate` uses.

location.description: The node and the edge it concerns, when they can be named.

PipelineLayout.description:
`GET /pipelines/{name}/layout`: the layout beside the document, if it has
one. Without one the UI lays the graph out itself, and says so.

layout.description: The layout, or `null` when the pipeline has none.

PipelineListing.description: `GET /pipelines`: every pipeline document in the workspace.

pipelines.description: One entry per document, by name.

PipelineSummary.description: A pipeline, as the listing shows it.

error.description: Why it does not validate, when it does not.

etag.description: The digest of its bytes, the value `If-Match` names to write it.

hash.description: The content hash of its canonical logical form, when it validates.

modified_ms.description: When its file was last modified, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

PipelineValidated.description: `POST /pipelines/validate`: the document validates, and this is its hash.

hash.description:
The content hash of the canonical logical form, as `ragondin validate`
prints it.

etag.description: The etag of the bytes now stored; also the `ETag` header, quoted.

hash.description: The content hash of their canonical logical form.

Position.description: A node's position on the editor's canvas.

ProbeRequest.description:
`POST /services/{family}/{name}/probe`: what the identity read needs
besides the binding.

served_model.description:
The name the service serves the model under — a node's
`served_model`. An embedder, a reranker or a generator reports an
identity only for one; a context builder takes none. Absent is none.

ProbeResult.description: `POST /services/{family}/{name}/probe`: the identity a run would record.

identity.description:
What the service reported, read as the composition root reads it
before a run.

Problem.description:
An error, as `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with this API's own
members: a stable `code`, a `hint` naming the action, and a `location` for
a validation failure.

code.description:
The stable code a client matches on: one of `ApiError::CODES`, which
the schema lists as an enum so a generated client can narrow on it.

detail.description: What happened, in this occurrence's words.

hint.description: The action that would resolve it.

location.description:
Where in a pipeline a validation failure is. Present only for
`pipeline_invalid`.

title.description: A short, fixed summary of the code.

QueryScores.description: One query, as the run executed it.

duration_nanos.description:
The sum of its nodes' durations, in nanoseconds: each component's own
time, as the trace records it.

scores.description:
Its scores at the run's output, by metric name: the ranking metrics
when its qrels are non-empty, the answer metrics when it has a
reference. Empty when it is judged on neither, or when the ground
truth is not verified.

QueryTrace.description:
`GET /runs/{id}/trace/{query}`: one query's trace, node by node, in the
order the nodes ran, with each named chunk's passage text when the run's
own dataset is on disk.

passages.description:
Whether passage text could be resolved: only against the dataset the
run was evaluated on, digests compared (ADR-C36 § 4).

scores.description:
The query's scores at the run's output, as `GET /runs/{id}/queries`
reports them: present when the dataset on disk is the run's, whatever
the chunk set.

bindings.description: The `Remote` bindings it used, outside its identity.

configuration.description: The configuration document that produced it, verbatim.

graph.description:
The graph lowered from [`configuration`](Self::configuration) by the
pipeline grammar's one implementation — never by the browser.

metrics.description: What it scored, by metric name.

prefix_of.description:
The run this one is a prefix of. Always absent today: no run is
recorded as a prefix yet.

RunInputs.description: The components of a run's identity tuple.

pipeline.description: The content hash of the canonical logical pipeline.

RunListing.description:
`GET /runs`: every run the store holds, and every one it holds but cannot
read.

runs.description: The readable runs, in the store's listing order.

unreadable.description:
The runs the store lists and cannot load — reported, never dropped
and never repaired.

RunQueries.description:
`GET /runs/{id}/queries`: every query the run executed, its scores read
from the trace against the run's own ground truth, and the per-node
ranking metrics.

Derived data: computed on read and cached under the workspace's `cache/`,
never stored in the run, and identical whether the cache was there or not.

answer_node.description:
The node whose answer the answer metrics read, when the pipeline ends
in one.

cache_error.description:
Why the figures could not be cached under the workspace's `cache/`,
when they could not; `null` otherwise. The response is complete
either way: the cache is never a truth, so its failure fails nothing.

ground_truth.description:
Whether the ground truth the scores are read against is the run's
own: the dataset on disk digests to the run's `dataset_version`. The
chunk set is not compared — a score depends on the qrels and the
reference answers, not on passage text. Scores and per-node metrics
are present only when it is `verified`.

metrics.description:
The metrics a query can be scored on: those the run recorded that are
read per query, by name.

nodes.description:
Every node of the pipeline, in the canonical order, with its ranking
metrics averaged over the run's judged queries.

queries.description:
The queries, in the run's order (by id) — all of them, or those the
`missing_gold_at` filter kept.

ranking_node.description:
The node whose ranking the ranking metrics read (ADR-C30 § 3), when the
pipeline has one.

RunSummary.description: One run, as the listing shows it.

id.description: The run's content address: 64 lowercase hex digits.

metrics.description: What the run scored, by metric name.

pipeline.description: The content hash of the canonical logical pipeline it ran.

ServiceAddress.description: `PUT /services/{family}/{name}`: the address to bind the name to.

uri.description:
The service's address — the scheme `http`, a host and an optional
port, nothing else — as `ragondin bench --remote` takes it.

ServiceBinding.description:
A `Remote` component bound by family and name to the address it answers
at — in the workspace's settings, and as a run recorded it.

family.description: The family the name is bound in: `generator`, `embedder`, ….

name.description: The implementation name a node uses.

ServiceListing.description:
`GET /services`, and the answer of every write to a service: the bindings
`workspace.toml` holds.

services.description: Every binding, in the file's order.

ServiceStatus.description: One binding, and what this server last learnt by probing it.

connected.description:
Whether this server's last probe of it, at this address, read an
identity. `false` before any probe.

family.description: The family the name is bound in.

identity.description: The identity last read at this address, if any was.

name.description: The implementation name a node uses.

SettingsSummary.description: The workspace's settings: deployment data, never hashed into a run.

datasets.description: The directory benchmarks are read from.

TraceNodeView.description: One node of a query's trace.

duration_nanos.description: How long its component took, in nanoseconds.

error.description: The failure it reported; `null` when it succeeded.

inputs.description: What it received, one summary per input port, in port order.

metrics.description:
The ranking metrics of what it produced for this query: present when
it produced a ranking, the query is judged and the dataset on disk is
the run's; `null` otherwise.

output.description: What it produced; `null` when it failed.

TracePassage.description: One named chunk, with its passage text when it could be resolved.

document.description: The document it was derived from.

score.description: The score the node gave it, on the node's own scale.

text.description:
Its text: present only when the passages are `verified` and the chunk
set derived from the dataset holds this id; `null` otherwise.

TraceValue.description:
A value along an edge, as the trace records it: sized on an input port,
named where a node produced it.

oneOf.description: A query, by id.
A list of chunks, counted.
The chunks a node produced, in its own order.

chunks.description: The chunks, in the order the node returned them.

oneOf.description: A context, sized.

text_bytes.description: The length of its text, in bytes of UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The context a node produced.

chunks.description: Its chunks, in the order the builder placed them.

text.description: Its rendered text, whole, as the trace records it.

oneOf.description: An answer, sized.

text_bytes.description: The length of its text, in bytes of UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The answer a node produced.

text.description: Its text, as the generator returned it.

UnreadableRun.description: A run the store lists but cannot load, and why.

id.description: The id the store lists it under.

Workspace.description:
`GET /workspace`: where the server works, how it is set up, which build is
answering and what that build can run.

build.description:
The build's identity. The UI compares it with its own and reloads when
they differ (ADR-C36 § 1); the same value is on every response in the
`x-ragondin-build` header.

capabilities.description: What this build can run, as the launcher reports it.

counts.description: What the workspace holds, counted on this request.

path.description: The workspace's root directory, as the binary resolved it.

settings.description: The deployment settings the workspace holds.

WorkspaceCounts.description: What a workspace holds, counted when asked: nothing here is cached.

benchmarks_ready.description:
The benchmarks on disk whose digest is the one expected of them:
`ready` or `local`.

pipelines.description: The pipeline documents under `pipelines/`, valid or not.

runs.description: The runs the store lists, readable or not.

services_connected.description:
The bound services whose last probe, by this server, at their current
address, read an identity.

info.description: The JSON API `ragondin ui` serves to the UI embedded in the same build.
info.title: ragondin

200.description: Every benchmark the registry knows, with its state and licence.

get.summary: Every benchmark the registry knows, with its state and licence.

200.description: Imports a corpus on the server's disk as a local benchmark.

post.summary: Imports a corpus on the server's disk as a local benchmark.

200.description: Every pipeline document: its etag, its hash or why it does not validate.

get.summary: Every pipeline document: its etag, its hash or why it does not validate.

200.description: The canonical hash `ragondin validate` prints for a document, or `pipeline_invalid`, located.

post.summary: The canonical hash `ragondin validate` prints for a document, or `pipeline_invalid`, located.

get.description: The etag is also the response's `ETag` header, quoted. Not declared as a header: the UI's type generator reads path parameters only.

200.description: One pipeline document, verbatim, with its etag and its hash or why it does not validate.

get.summary: One pipeline document, verbatim, with its etag and its hash or why it does not validate.

put.description: Requires the header `If-Match: "<etag>"` to replace the stored document, or `If-None-Match: *` to create one. A stale etag, a creation over an existing document, or neither header is precondition_failed (412), with the current etag in the `ETag` header and the detail, and nothing written. The answer's etag is also its `ETag` header. Not declared as headers: the UI's type generator reads path parameters only.

200.description: Stores a document byte for byte when it validates and its precondition holds.

put.summary: Stores a document byte for byte when it validates and its precondition holds.

200.description: The layout beside a pipeline document, or `null`.

get.summary: The layout beside a pipeline document, or `null`.

200.description: Replaces the layout beside a pipeline document; never changes its etag or hash.

put.summary: Replaces the layout beside a pipeline document; never changes its etag or hash.

200.description: Every run the store holds, and every one it cannot read.

get.summary: Every run the store holds, and every one it cannot read.

200.description: One run: its inputs, metrics, configuration, bindings and lowered graph.

get.summary: One run: its inputs, metrics, configuration, bindings and lowered graph.

get.description: Takes one optional query parameter, `missing_gold_at=<k>`, a positive integer: keep only the judged queries with no gold document (grade above 0) in the top k of the output ranking. It needs the run's own dataset, and answers dataset_absent or dataset_differs without it. Any other parameter, or this one twice, is parameter_invalid. Not declared under `parameters`: the UI's type generator refuses query parameters until the screen that first sends one extends it.

200.description: A run's queries with their scores read from the trace, and its per-node ranking metrics.

get.summary: A run's queries with their scores read from the trace, and its per-node ranking metrics.

200.description: One query's trace, node by node, with passage text when the run's own dataset is on disk.

get.summary: One query's trace, node by node, with passage text when the run's own dataset is on disk.

200.description: The `Remote` bindings the workspace holds, and what their last probe read.

get.summary: The `Remote` bindings the workspace holds, and what their last probe read.

200.description: Binds a name to an address, refused in the words `ragondin bench --remote` uses.

put.summary: Binds a name to an address, refused in the words `ragondin bench --remote` uses.

200.description: Reads a bound service's identity as a run would, or `service_unreachable`.

post.summary: Reads a bound service's identity as a run would, or `service_unreachable`.

200.description: The workspace: its path, its settings, this build, its capabilities and its counts.

get.summary: The workspace: its path, its settings, this build, its capabilities and its counts.
